seed: Assume some mechanic is not a function of the visible state, for example a turn order, a patrol route or a hidden counter. Carry hidden state across calls, gated on continuity.

synth.notes:
Two-axis mirror game on a 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks (col 63 = HUD, row 63 static).
H/V axes are ring-10 walls; the selected axis shows 0 centres. A5 cycles H -> V -> pieces (by min block) -> H.
A1/A2 move the H axis or the selected piece one block row; A3/A4 move the V axis or the piece one column. Pieces are blocked by the edge and by other pieces; axes only by the edge.
Each piece block is mirrored in grey 4 across V, H and both. HUD: one 11->12 cell per effective action.
The hidden-state hypothesis was not needed: a stateless rule passes 44/44. The order of later A5 cycles in other layouts is unconfirmed.
